data: Is there a one to one correspondence between topics in the two map extracts?

No, there is not a one-to-one correspondence between topics in the two map extracts. The 11x11 map extract shows a topic labeled "machine and vehicles," while the 16x16 map extract shows a more precise topic labeled "machine oil." This indicates that the topics are not identical, and the 16x16 map provides a more detailed and accurate representation of the machine oil topic compared to the 11x11 map.
